- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, screens, and control elements.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch-control styling.

- Original request: “A 3d dragton ride pure open works high graphic player and dragon movemt adventure dragon fights hilss villages lakes rivers open world map quests and many more”.

- Complete the existing browser-based 3D dragon-riding adventure as a playable game with exploration, quests, and combat.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Use Three.js with procedural terrain, a custom dragon, keyboard and touch controls, three ember shrines, and wisp combat.

### Completed
- Implemented the valley, dragon, shrines, wisps, HUD, minimap, keyboard/touch controls, flight, combat, shrine attunement, pause, replay, and victory flow in `game.js`.

## Objective
- Complete the browser-based 3D dragon-riding adventure as a playable game with exploration, quests, and combat.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js with procedural terrain, a custom dragon, keyboard and touch controls, three ember shrines, and wisp combat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the valley, dragon, shrines, wisps, HUD, minimap, keyboard/touch controls, flight, combat, shrine attunement, pause, replay, and victory flow.
- Optimized rendering with capped pixel ratio, disabled shadows, and instanced trees; increased the frame delta cap to `.15`.
- Fixed touch dash state handling.
- Browser-tested keyboard turning, flight, dash, and shrine-distance updates.
- Verified mobile touch controls: joystick movement, climbing, dash control, and fire projectile creation.
- Verified proximity damage from a wisp and all three shrine attunements, including victory at `3 / 3`; replay reset health, embers, and dragon position.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest temporary test hooks were added.

### Active
- Remove temporary `window.__flightDebug` and `window.__gameTest` instrumentation from `game.js`.
- Retest wisp projectile hits and replay screen state; current browser checks did not confirm wisp defeat, and the win-screen visibility reading after replay was inconsistent.
- Run `node --check game.js`, capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px, then summarize results.

### Blocked
- Browser performance remains low under software WebGL (ANGLE/Mesa llvmpipe), limiting test speed.

## Next Move
1. Remove both temporary window test hooks from `game.js`.
2. Verify combat defeat and replay screen behavior in the browser; investigate any failures.
3. Run `node --check game.js`; capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize completed features, tests, and reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, gameplay systems, controls, and temporary debug/test hooks.
- `index.html`: Game interface, HUD, touch controls, and screens.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- Changes remain uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` as untracked.
- The game runs at `http://localhost:3000/`; port `3002` refused connections.
- Latest mobile viewport check used 390×844; touch controls were visible. A reliable follow-up joystick test showed movement and turning.
- The combat test showed health damage but did not establish wisp defeat: the wisp remained alive with 2 health and one projectile was still active.
- After victory, replay reset dragon position, health, and ember count, but the test still reported the win screen visible and start screen hidden; verify the actual UI state.
